title: Side Path — Field Engineering
purpose: Turn proven industrial machines into ambitious physical systems that reward hands-on engineering without gating the main campaign.

milestones.title: The Walking Quarry
milestones.capability: Build a non-teleporting ProjectRed frame carriage that recovers one exhausted BuildCraft Quarry, advances one lane, redeploys that same Quarry, and resumes extraction.
final_validation: Mount the Mobile Quarry Controller, ProjectRed Block Breaker and Block Placer, redstone bus, Quarry recovery path, and output route on one connected frame carriage.
Leave the Block Placer empty before the run so the broken Quarry itself must travel through the recovery path.
Keep both lanes loaded with one fixed, fueled Standard Worldspike; do not use teleport pipes, teleport tethers, or a spare Quarry.
Run the first Quarry to bedrock and let the controller command all 16 verified frame steps without manual pulses.
Confirm that the recovered Quarry is placed at the next lane and resumes frame construction and excavation.
automation_paths: ProjectRed Block Breaker and Block Placer
Physical hopper recovery and BuildCraft output routing
